title: ep.decode
description: Decode one raw-topic record value (EP-C1..C5, EP-D5). Rule: the bytes must be one JSON object (the literal `null` decodes to an event whose fields are all empty, EP-C3); recognised fields and accepted JSON types per EP-C1 (strings with JSON null read as "", `precise_total_amount_cents` string only in the reference, `properties` object or null, `source_metadata` {api_post_processed: boolean} or null, `timestamp` any JSON value kept as received, `ingested_at` per EP-D5); unknown keys are dropped and a repeated key keeps its last value (EP-C4). Anything else (invalid JSON, empty value, array or scalar, a recognised field of the wrong type, an unparsable `ingested_at`) is the domain error `undecodable` in both profiles. The output is the dead-letter copy of the decoded event (wire-formats.md section 4, field `event`) in the suite's canonical form (wire-formats.md section 7, EP-W7): object keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace, no HTML escaping, number literals as the implementation writes them (reference: binary64 shortest text, EP-C5; corrected RBD-14: the literal text).

x-kit-errors.when: the record value is not a decodable event object (EP-C2)

raw_b64.description: The exact record value bytes, standard base64 with padding ("" = empty value).

event_json.description: Canonical JSON text of the decoded event (sorted keys, literal number text, no HTML escaping); compared as text.

event.description: Optional: the same event as a JSON object (not graded by the v1 vectors).
